title: Fix layout thrashing in canvas-gesture.js
description: getBoundingClientRect() called 6+ times per touch event causing 5-10ms per touch event. Found in canvas-gesture.js - called on EVERY touch event without caching. Fix: Cache rect at touchstart, reuse for touchmove/touchend. Also cache window dimensions.

comments.author: anno
comments.text:
FIXED: Layout thrashing in canvas-gesture.js

Changes made:
1. Added rect caching system (_cachedCanvasRect, _cachedScreenHeight, _rectCacheTime)
2. Added _getCanvasRect() - returns cached rect, refreshes if >100ms stale
3. Added _refreshRectCache() - force refresh at gesture start
4. Updated resizeCanvas() to invalidate cache on window resize
5. Updated getTouchZone() to use cached screen height
6. Updated all touch handlers (touchstart/move/end) to use cached rect
7. Updated all mouse handlers (mousedown/move/up) to use cached rect
8. Fixed isInteractiveElement() to avoid getComputedStyle - checks inline styles and common classes instead

Performance impact: Reduced from 6+ getBoundingClientRect() calls per touch event to 1 at gesture start (cached thereafter). Eliminates ~5-10ms per touch event of layout thrashing.

title: Fix circular dependencies in sigma modules
description:
The modularized sigma files have circular dependencies that prevent the barrel file from working:

**CIRCULAR CHAINS:**
- sigma-core.js → sigma-layouts.js → sigma-core.js
- sigma-core.js → sigma-selection.js → sigma-core.js
- sigma-core.js → sigma-properties.js → sigma-core.js

**ROOT CAUSE:**
sigma-core.js imports from layouts/selection/properties
layouts/selection/properties import DEFAULT_NODE_ATTRIBUTES from core

When modules import each other, exports are undefined during init.

**FIX OPTIONS:**
1. Extract shared constants to sigma-constants.js
2. Use late binding (function calls instead of top-level imports)
3. Restructure module boundaries

This BLOCKS the modularization migration (xpu, df3, wwq).

Found by: lapu, anna, godi via collaborative debugging
